points.description: Names at least about four to five relevant factors affecting evaporation from the model list (wind speed, temperature of water/air, vapour pressure, atmospheric pressure, heat storage in water body, water quality, surface area). Any wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for two or three correct factors; 0 for none.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for about five correct factors from the model list, in any wording (e.g. 'wind', 'temperature', 'humidity/vapour pressure' count). Give 1 mark for two or three correct factors. Give 0 if none are correct. Wrong extra items do not lose marks.
